s: Moses leads children of Israel (onward from the Red Sea into the wilderness)
q: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea

s: Miriam is a prophetess
q: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron

s: Miriam is sister of Aaron
q: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron

s: Pharaoh has chariots
q: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea.

s: wilderness of Sin located between Elim (between Elim and Sinai)
q: the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai

s: Sabbath has rule no manna found in the field
q: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.

s: murmuring of Israel directed against LORD (not against Moses and Aaron)
q: Your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.

s: Aaron keeps pot (Aaron's pot of manna) (laid up before the Testimony)
q: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

s: wilderness of Sin located between Mount Sinai (between Elim and Sinai)
q: the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai

s: manna named by children of Israel (the house of Israel called it Manna)
q: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”

s: manna appearance like white coriander seed
q: it was like coriander seed, white

s: manna taste like wafers with honey
q: its taste was like wafers with honey

s: manna is a bread given by the LORD
q: It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.

s: manna melts when the sun grows hot
q: When the sun grew hot, it melted.

s: children of Israel eat manna (for forty years until reaching Canaan)
q: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land.

s: Sabbath is a solemn rest holy to the LORD (falls on the seventh day)
q: Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD.

s: Moses leads children of Israel (people he led out of Egypt)
q: Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?

s: Amalek was defeated by Joshua (with the edge of the sword)
q: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

s: Rephidim has lack of water (no water for the people to drink)
q: encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

s: Massah and Meribah named because quarrel over water (Israel quarreled and tested the LORD)
q: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the LORD

s: rock (in Horeb) located in Mount Sinai (where the LORD stood before Moses)
q: I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb.

s: rock (in Horeb) yields water (when struck by Moses)
q: You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.

s: quarrel over water is between children of Israel (quarreled with Moses)
q: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.”

s: battle with Amalek occurs at Rephidim
q: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

s: memorial book (Moses' record) records battle with Amalek (written as a memorial)
q: Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua

s: Moses holds rod (Moses' rod) (rod with which he struck the Nile)
q: take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.

s: Moses named Massah and Meribah (name given to the place of the quarrel)
q: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah

s: Moses built altar (built by Moses)
q: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.

s: Moses commands Joshua (chose men and fought Amalek at Moses' instruction)
q: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek.

s: LORD has war with Amalek (from generation to generation)
q: The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’

s: LORD intends to blot out Amalek (the memory of Amalek from under the sky)
q: I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.

s: children of Israel encamped at Rephidim (after traveling from the wilderness of Sin)
q: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the LORD’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim

s: children of Israel fought Amalek (at Rephidim)
q: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

s: Jethro is a priest of Midian
q: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law

s: Jethro believes that the LORD is greater than all gods (after hearing of the deliverance)
q: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods

s: Aaron accompanies elders of Israel (to eat bread with Jethro before God)
q: Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

s: judges and rulers (appointed by Moses) are chosen from able men out of all Israel (fear God, men of truth, hating unjust gain)
q: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people
